paragraphs.text: 1. MAY the wind blow upon our Cows with healing: may they eat herbage full of vigorous juices.
May they drink waters rich in life and fatness: to food that moves on feet be gracious, Rudra.
2. Like-coloured, various-hued, or single-coloured, whose names through sacrifice are known to Agni,
paragraphs.original: याः सरूपा विरूपा एकरूपा यासामग्निरिष्ट्या नामानि वेद ।
paragraphs.translit: yāḥ sarūpā virūpā ekarūpā yāsāmagniriṣṭyā nāmāni veda |

paragraphs.text: Whom the Angirases produced by Fervour, vouchsafe to these, Parjanya, great protection.
paragraphs.original: या अङ्गिरसस्तपसेह चक्रुस्ताभ्यः पर्जन्य महि शर्म यच्छ
paragraphs.translit: yā aṅgirasastapaseha cakrustābhyaḥ parjanya mahi śarma yaccha

paragraphs.text: 3. Those who have offered to the Gods their bodies, whose varied forms are all well known to Soma,-
paragraphs.original: या देवेषु तन्वमैरयन्त यासां सोमो विश्वा रूपाणि वेद ।
paragraphs.translit: yā deveṣu tanvamairayanta yāsāṃ somo viśvā rūpāṇi veda |

paragraphs.text: Those grant us in our cattle-pen, O Indra, with their full streams of milk and plenteous offspring.
paragraphs.original: ता अस्मभ्यं पयसा पिन्वमानाः प्रजावतीरिन्द्र गोष्ठे रिरीहि
paragraphs.translit: tā asmabhyaṃ payasā pinvamānāḥ prajāvatīrindra goṣṭhe rirīhi

paragraphs.text: 4. Prajapati, bestowing these upon me, one-minded with all Gods and with the Fathers,
Hath to our cow-pen brought auspicious cattle: so may we own the offspring they will bear us.
paragraphs.original: शिवाः सतीरुप नो गोष्ठमाकस्तासां वयं प्रजया सं सदेम
paragraphs.translit: śivāḥ satīrupa no goṣṭhamākastāsāṃ vayaṃ prajayā saṃ sadema
